voice.name: Bacbuc - Audiobooks
voice.why: A warm middle-aged French narrator voice: the depot's parcel sorter, friendly and a little dry.

greet_refuses.text: No. I have heard what you did. Leave me be.

greet.text: Anselme Caron. I sort the parcels at the depot, so if your post is late, blame the ferry, not me.

greet_friendly.text: Hello, hello. No parcel for you today, I am afraid.

greet_regular.text: Ah, my friend! Marius made too much soup again. Come by tonight.

about_work.text: Letters, parcels, the odd crate of machine parts for the farms. If you want work, the depot pays by the drop. Ask at the counter.

about_family.text: Marius is my brother. He spends his mornings at the cafe and knows everything before the newspaper does.

about_town.text: We came over from the mainland long before all this. Now half the street are new faces from the Zone. Good people. Tired people.

about_van.text: The van run? Take the yellow van from the post stand, load four mail sacks, drive them to the post office in Meaux and bring my van back. Back in one piece, mind. A wrecked van pays nobody.

replies.work: What do you do at the depot?
replies.van: Tell me about the van run.
